manifest.name: @loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service
manifest.description: Multi-provider text-to-speech (TTS) service for dsh: Doubao TTS 2.0, Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers register independently and the user picks the voice; the agent can speak with per-segment tone, and other plugins reuse the same service.
manifest.author: loveandbeepbrother

bundle.text:
# 语音合成服务：一个包里的几个独立条目，在插件页分别开关。
# 平台条目默认关闭：开哪家就配哪家（密钥只写名字，值存在设置页的密钥里或启动环境里）。
# 本机音箱去向只在 Windows 上注册。
- insert:
    - id: tts-service
      name: '@loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service'
    - id: tts-doubao
      name: '@loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service/doubao'
      disabled: true
    - id: tts-bailian
      name: '@loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service/bailian'
      disabled: true
    - id: tts-openai-compatible
      name: '@loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service/openai-compatible'
      disabled: true
    - id: tts-say
      name: '@loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service/say'
    - id: tts-speaker-windows
      name: '@loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service/speaker-windows'

readme.text:
English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Multi-provider text-to-speech (TTS) service for [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): Doubao TTS 2.0,
Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers register independently and the user picks the voice; the agent can
speak with per-segment tone, and other plugins reuse the same service.

One package, several plugin entries that you switch on and off separately on the DSH plugin page:

| Entry id | What it does | On by default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tts-service` | The service `ctx.ttsService`: provider registry, selection (provider, voice per provider, language), synthesis, voice listing. | yes |
| `tts-doubao` | Provider: Doubao (Volcengine) TTS 2.0. | **no** |
| `tts-bailian` | Provider: Alibaba Bailian / Model Studio (CosyVoice, Qwen-Audio-TTS, Qwen3-TTS). | **no** |
| `tts-openai-compatible` | Provider: any endpoint compatible with `POST /audio/speech`. | **no** |
| `tts-say` | Agent tools `tts_service_say`, `tts_service_voices` and `tts_service_select`, plus the output registry `ctx.ttsSay`. | yes |
| `tts-speaker-windows` | Output: play on the PC speakers when you are at the computer (Windows only; registers nothing elsewhere). | yes |

There is **no default provider and no default voice**. Until you pick one, `tts_service_say` fails with
`VOICE_NOT_SELECTED` and tells the agent where to pick it.

This version synthesizes whole clips (no streaming).

- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0` (prereleases included). Tests run against the 0.2.1-rc.5 packages.
- Node.js 22 or newer (the one that ships with DSH is fine).
- An account and API key for at least one provider (see below). Synthesis is billed by the provider.
- For the speaker output: Windows with Windows PowerShell (`powershell.exe`, present by default).

```sh
dsh plugin add @loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service
```

or from GitHub: `dsh plugin add github:loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service`.

1. On the plugin page, switch on **one provider entry** (`tts-doubao`, `tts-bailian` or `tts-openai-compatible`) and
   fill in its form.
2. Store its API key in DSH's credential store (see [Keys](#keys)).
3. Pick a voice: ask the agent "list the available voices" and then "use voice X", or set it yourself in the settings
   of **Text-to-Speech Service** (`tts-service`): `provider` = the provider id (e.g. `doubao`), and an entry in
   `voices`: provider id → voice id. See [Choosing a voice](#choosing-a-voice).
4. Ask the agent to say something.

Configuration never contains secret values, only **key names**. The value comes from DSH's credential service
(`ctx.credentials`, the key store on the settings page) or, when no credential service is loaded, from the environment
DSH was launched with. Keys are read on every request, so a rotated key applies immediately. The settings page shows
only whether a key is configured.

| Entry | Config field | Default key name | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tts-doubao` | `apiKeyEnv` | `VOLCENGINE_TTS_API_KEY` | Synthesis (an API key from the Volcengine console, "API Key 管理"). |
| `tts-doubao` | `accessKeyEnv`, `secretKeyEnv` | `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY`, `VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | Optional: your Volcengine account AK/SK, only to list the complete voice catalogue. |
| `tts-bailian` | `apiKeyEnv` | `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` | Synthesis and listing cloned voices (same name as the official DashScope SDK). |
| `tts-openai-compatible` | `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_TTS_API_KEY` | Sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Leave the field empty for local endpoints that need no key. |
You can rename any of them, e.g. to keep keys for two endpoints apart.

The selection lives in the `tts-service` settings and is saved to your profile without a restart:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `provider` | Default provider id. Empty means none. |
| `voices` | Default voice **per provider**: provider id → voice id. Voice ids only make sense within their provider, so switching from Doubao to Bailian and back keeps both choices. |
| `language` | Default language code, `auto` by default. Must be one the provider declares. |
There are three ways to set it; all of them write the same settings and take effect immediately:

1. **Settings page**: edit `provider` and `voices` in the *Text-to-Speech Service* settings.
2. **Ask the agent**: "which voices are there?" (`tts_service_voices`), then "switch to …" (`tts_service_select`). The
   agent's reply states the old and new voice and what to enter to change it back; you can also change it back on
   the settings page.
3. **From a plugin**: `await ctx.ttsService.configure({ provider: 'doubao', voices: { doubao: 'voice-id' } })`.

`tts_service_voices` (or `ctx.ttsService.voices(id)` for plugins) lists voices with their languages and whether they
follow tone descriptions. Lists that cannot be complete say so; you can always type a voice id by hand.

Errors are explicit: a provider that is not registered, a language it does not support, text longer than its
`maxChars`, or a format it cannot produce all fail. The service never silently switches to another provider.

| Field | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `providerId` | `doubao` | Change it if you run two copies. |
| `resourceId` | `seed-tts-2.0` | Sent as `X-Api-Resource-Id`. |
| `apiKeyEnv`, `accessKeyEnv`, `secretKeyEnv` | see [Keys](#keys) | |
| `sampleRate` | `24000` | 16-bit mono PCM. |
| `maxChars` | `300` | Per request. |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | |

- Tone descriptions and the "context" (the user's last sentence) are combined into one voice instruction and sent as
  `additions.context_texts`. **Only Doubao 2.0 system voices** (ids containing `uranus`) follow it; cloned voices do not.
- Voice listing: without AK/SK you get a static table of 2.0 system voices transcribed from the
  [official voice list](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6561/1257544), marked incomplete. With AK/SK the plugin calls
  the official `ListSpeakers` API (signed with HMAC-SHA256, service `speech_saas_prod`, region `cn-beijing`).
- Languages: `auto`, `zh`, `en`, `ja` (sent as `explicit_language`).

| Field | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `cosyvoice-v3-flash` | e.g. `cosyvoice-v3-flash`, `cosyvoice-v3-plus`, `cosyvoice-v2`, `cosyvoice-v3.5-flash`, `qwen-audio-3.1-tts-flash`, `qwen3-tts-flash`. Voices only work with their own model. |
| `region` | `cn-beijing` | `cn-beijing`, `ap-southeast-1`, `cn-hongkong`, `us-east-1`, `eu-central-1`, `ap-northeast-1`. Keys, workspaces and models are per region. |
| `workspaceId` | — | The first label of your API host (e.g. `llm-xxx`). When set, the workspace domain `{workspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com` is used; otherwise the older DashScope domain. Required for `eu-central-1` and `ap-northeast-1`. Alibaba Cloud says the DashScope domain gets no new features after 2026-09-30, so setting it is recommended. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` | |
| `sampleRate` | `24000` | CosyVoice / Qwen-Audio-TTS; Qwen3-TTS is fixed at 24000. |
| `maxChars` | 600 for Qwen3-TTS, 2000 otherwise | |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Covers the synthesis call and the audio download. |

- CosyVoice and Qwen-Audio-TTS use `/api/v1/services/audio/tts/SpeechSynthesizer`; Qwen3-TTS uses
  `/api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation`. Both return a 24-hour audio URL, which the plugin downloads.
- Tone descriptions (`instruction`), per the official docs:

| Model | Follows free-form tone descriptions |
  | --- | --- |
  | `qwen-audio-*` | yes, system, cloned and designed voices (a few English voices excepted) |
  | `cosyvoice-v3.5-*` | yes (this model only has cloned and designed voices) |
  | `cosyvoice-v3-flash` | cloned and designed voices only; system voices accept only fixed instruction templates |
  | `cosyvoice-v3-plus`, `cosyvoice-v2` | no |
  | `qwen3-tts-instruct-*` | yes (sent as `instructions`) |
  | `qwen3-tts-flash` | no |

CosyVoice instructions are limited to 100 characters (CJK characters count as two).
- Voice listing: system voices from a static table transcribed from the official
  [CosyVoice](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/cosyvoice-voice-list),
  [Qwen-Audio-TTS](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/qwen-audio-tts-voice-list) and
  [Qwen3-TTS](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/qwen-tts-voice-list) lists; your cloned and designed voices
  for the configured model come from the official `voice-enrollment` `list_voice` API.

| Field | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `OpenAI 兼容接口` | Display name. |
| `baseUrl` | required | e.g. `https://example.com/v1`; the plugin calls `{baseUrl}/audio/speech`. |
| `model` | required | |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_TTS_API_KEY` | Empty: no `Authorization` header. |
| `instructions` | `false` | Set to `true` if the endpoint accepts the `instructions` parameter. |
| `voices` | `[]` | Hand-written voice table, used when `GET {baseUrl}/audio/voices` is not available. Each entry can set `instructions: false`. |
| `languages` | `["auto"]` | Only used to validate the selected language; not sent. |
| `maxChars` | `4096` | |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | |

The plugin always requests `response_format: "wav"` and needs 16-bit PCM WAV back. To use two endpoints, add a second
row to your profile with another `providerId`.

> This is **not** "the OpenAI integration". Note that OpenAI's own three speech models are scheduled to be retired on
> 2027-01-06; check the vendor's current model list before pointing this entry at it.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `segments` | 1–12 segments, spoken in order. Each has `text` and an optional `tone` (one short natural-language description, at most 40 characters). |
| `context` | Optional: the user's last sentence (at most 60 characters). Providers that support it use it to pick the tone. |
| `target` | `auto` (default) or the id of one output. |

Each segment is synthesized separately as 16-bit PCM, joined with 0.25 s of silence into one WAV file and handed to an
output. The result (a JSON string) has `route` (the output id, or `kept`), `file`, `seconds`, `detail`, the outputs that
were `unavailable` and why, and `tone`: when a segment's tone was not applied it says so, so the agent can stop writing
tones for that voice.

`tts-say` settings:

| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outputs` | `["speaker-windows"]` | Outputs tried in order for `target: "auto"`; the first available one is used. |
| `maxChars` | `300` | Total characters per call. |
| `retentionDays` | `0` | Keep audio of the last N days (today included); `0` keeps everything. |

Audio files are stored at `<DSH home>/tts-say/audio/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<HHMMSS>-<id>.wav` (local date) and are **not deleted
automatically** unless you set `retentionDays`. `<DSH home>` is `~/.dsh` unless you set `DSH_HOME`.

Lists the current selection and, per provider, its voices. Optional parameters: `provider`, `language`, `search`
(substring of id, name or description) and `refresh`. At most 60 voices per provider are shown. Pressing stop ends it
right away, even while a provider is still answering.

Changes the voice for the user. The tool description tells the agent to use it **only** when you ask to change the
voice or explicitly agree to one; because that is only an instruction to the model, the change is also made visible
and reversible in the result itself.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `voice` | Required: the voice id. |
| `provider` | Optional: the provider id; defaults to the current default provider (an error asks for it when there is none). |

Before saving it checks the provider's voice list. If the list is complete and the id is not in it, nothing is saved
and the agent is told to look it up with `tts_service_voices`. If the list is incomplete or cannot be fetched, the id
is saved as typed, with a note that it is not in the known list. The result always states the selection before and
after (with voice names when known), that it is already in effect, that you can see and change it in the
*Text-to-Speech Service* settings, and the exact values that restore the previous state.

`speaker-windows` counts as available when there was keyboard or mouse input in the last `presentMinutes` (default 5)
and the screen is not locked (Windows PowerShell: `GetLastInputInfo`, `LogonUI.exe`). Playback uses
`System.Media.SoundPlayer`, one clip at a time; the tool does not wait for it to finish.

A provider is a plugin that injects `ttsService` and registers an object implementing `TtsProvider` (types in
[`index.d.ts`](./index.d.ts)):

```js
export const name = 'my-tts'
export const inject = ['ttsService']

export function apply(ctx) {

- `register` throws if the id is taken and returns an async disposer; `ctx.effect` calls it when your plugin unloads.
  Unregistering rejects new requests, aborts the `signal` of running ones and waits for them.
- Report `instructionsApplied: true` only when the tone description was actually used.
- The service does not convert formats. The bundled tool asks for `pcm16`.

Calling the service from another plugin: `inject = ['ttsService']`, then
`const audio = await ctx.ttsService.synthesize(ctx.ttsService.resolve({ text, formats: ['wav'] }), signal)`.

An output is a plugin that injects `ttsSay` and registers a `VoiceOutput`, for example to send the clip to a chat app:

```js
export const name = 'my-voice-output'
export const inject = ['ttsSay']

export function apply(ctx) {

Then add its id to `outputs` in the `tts-say` settings, e.g. `["speaker-windows", "my-chat"]`.

Real synthesis was checked on 2026-11-04 with these combinations, all returning `pcm16` at 24 kHz:

| Provider | Model / resource | Voice | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Doubao | `seed-tts-2.0` | `ICL_uranus_zh_female_wenrounvshen_tob` | tone description applied |
| Alibaba Bailian | `cosyvoice-v3-flash` | system voice | |
| Alibaba Bailian | `qwen3-tts-flash` | system voice | |
| Alibaba Bailian | `qwen-audio-3.1-tts-flash` | system voice | |

- Bailian `qwen3-tts-instruct-*`: where `instructions` goes in the HTTP body (`input.instructions`) is inferred from the
  official SDK example, not from the HTTP reference.
- Bailian without `workspaceId`: whether the old DashScope domain still serves newer models after 2026-09-30 is not
  confirmed. Set `workspaceId` if a model is rejected.
- Per-request character limits are conservative guesses where the docs give none: Doubao 300, Bailian
  SpeechSynthesizer (CosyVoice, Qwen-Audio-TTS) 2000. Both can be changed with `maxChars`.
- Doubao: the accepted `explicit_language` values (`zh-cn`, `en`, `ja` are sent) and the format of the language field
  in `ListSpeakers` responses are not confirmed.
- The static voice tables are transcribed from the official pages and may be incomplete or contain mistakes, so
  lists built from them (Doubao without AK/SK, all Bailian lists) are always marked incomplete and
  `tts_service_select` accepts ids that are not in them. You can always type a voice id by hand.
Every provider bills you directly under its own terms; this plugin adds no fees.

- Doubao / Volcengine: [billing overview](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/doubao-voice/billing-overview?lang=zh),
  [Volcengine Terms of Service](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6256/64903).
- Alibaba Bailian (Model Studio): [model pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/billing-for-model-studio),
  [agreements](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/related-agreements).
- OpenAI-compatible endpoints: whatever the endpoint's operator charges and requires.

The text, tone descriptions and context are sent to the provider you selected. Doubao requests go to
`openspeech.bytedance.com` (and `open.volcengineapi.com` for listing); Bailian requests go to your region's DashScope
or workspace domain, and the audio is downloaded from the URL it returns; OpenAI-compatible requests go to your
`baseUrl`. Nothing else leaves the machine unless an output sends the audio.

readme.section: When DSH ships its own `textToSpeech` service
readme.text:
DSH's speech-recognition docs list speech synthesis as future work. If it ships, it will almost certainly be called
`ctx.textToSpeech`. Cordis service names are global, so this package uses `ctx.ttsService` and both can run side by
side. We will then publish a major version that:

readme.section: When DSH ships its own `textToSpeech` service
When DSH ships its own `textToSpeech` service
readme.text:
| Here (`tts-service` settings and provider entries) | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| `provider` | the upstream default provider |
| `voices` (per provider) | the upstream per-provider voice setting |
| `language` | the upstream language |
| each provider's `apiKeyEnv` (and Doubao's AK/SK names) | the same key names; stored values in the credential store need no change |

readme.section: When DSH ships its own `textToSpeech` service
readme.text:
The interface here deliberately mirrors the upstream speech-recognition service, so provider implementations should
change very little.

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

Tests use `node --test`. Every network call goes through a fake `fetch`, and PowerShell is stubbed, so the tests make
no network requests and play no sound. The Volcengine signature is checked against the worked examples in the official
signing guide.

DSH is developed by DeepSeek. This plugin is an independent project and is not affiliated with DeepSeek, Volcengine,
Alibaba Cloud or OpenAI.

[English](./README.md) | 简体中文

[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的多平台语音合成（TTS）服务：豆包语音合成 2.0、阿里百炼、
OpenAI 兼容接口各自作为平台注册，用户自选音色；agent 可以开口说话、朗读指定内容并分段指定语气，其他插件也能调用同一个服务。

一个包里有几个独立的插件条目，在 DSH 插件页分别开关：

| 条目 id | 作用 | 默认开 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tts-service` | 服务 `ctx.ttsService`：平台注册、选择（平台、各平台的音色、语言）、合成、列音色。 | 是 |
| `tts-doubao` | 平台：豆包语音合成 2.0（火山引擎）。 | **否** |
| `tts-bailian` | 平台：阿里百炼（CosyVoice、Qwen-Audio-TTS、Qwen3-TTS）。 | **否** |
| `tts-openai-compatible` | 平台：任何兼容 `POST /audio/speech` 的端点。 | **否** |
| `tts-say` | agent 工具 `tts_service_say`、`tts_service_voices`、`tts_service_select`，以及去向注册表 `ctx.ttsSay`。 | 是 |
| `tts-speaker-windows` | 去向：你在电脑前时用本机音箱播放（仅 Windows；别的系统上什么也不注册）。 | 是 |

**不带默认平台，也不带默认音色。** 选好之前，`tts_service_say` 会报 `VOICE_NOT_SELECTED`，并告诉 agent 去哪里选。

这一版只做整段音频，不做流式。

- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`（含预发布版）。测试跑在 0.2.1-rc.5 的包上。
- Node.js 22 或更新（DSH 自带的即可）。
- 至少一家平台的账号和 API Key（见下文）。合成费用由平台收取。
- 本机音箱去向：Windows，带 Windows PowerShell（`powershell.exe`，系统默认就有）。

```sh
dsh plugin add @loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service
```

或者从 GitHub 装：`dsh plugin add github:loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service`。

1. 在插件页打开**一个平台条目**（`tts-doubao`、`tts-bailian` 或 `tts-openai-compatible`），填好它的表单。
2. 把它的 API Key 存进 DSH 的密钥里（见[密钥](#密钥)）。
3. 选音色：对 agent 说“列出可用音色”，再说“换成某某音色”；或者自己在**语音合成服务**（`tts-service`）的设置里，
   把 `provider` 设成平台 id（例如 `doubao`），在 `voices` 里加一项：平台 id → 音色 ID。见[选音色](#选音色)。
4. 让 agent 说句话试试。

配置里从不写密钥的值，只写**密钥名**。值来自 DSH 的密钥服务（`ctx.credentials`，也就是设置页里的密钥），
没有加载密钥服务时，读启动 DSH 时的环境变量。每次请求现取，换了密钥立即生效。设置页只显示“有没有配好”。

| 条目 | 配置项 | 默认密钥名 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tts-doubao` | `apiKeyEnv` | `VOLCENGINE_TTS_API_KEY` | 合成（火山引擎控制台“API Key 管理”里创建）。 |
| `tts-doubao` | `accessKeyEnv`、`secretKeyEnv` | `VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY`、`VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY` | 可选：火山引擎账号的 AK/SK，只用于列出完整音色。 |
| `tts-bailian` | `apiKeyEnv` | `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` | 合成、列复刻音色（和百炼官方 SDK 用的名字一样）。 |
| `tts-openai-compatible` | `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_TTS_API_KEY` | 作为 `Authorization: Bearer` 发出。本机端点不要密钥时留空。 |

密钥名都可以改，比如两个端点各用一个。

选择保存在 `tts-service` 的设置里，写回 profile，不用重启：

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `provider` | 默认平台 id。空表示没有。 |
| `voices` | **每个平台各自的**默认音色：平台 id → 音色 ID。音色 ID 只在本平台内有意义，所以从豆包换到百炼再换回来，不用重选。 |
| `language` | 默认语言代码，默认 `auto`。必须是平台声明支持的。 |

有三种选法，写的都是同一份设置，改完立即生效：

1. **设置页**：在“语音合成服务”的设置里改 `provider` 和 `voices`。
2. **对 agent 说**：“有哪些音色？”（`tts_service_voices`），再说“换成……”（`tts_service_select`）。agent 的回复会写明
   改前改后的音色，以及改回原样要填什么；也可以在设置页改回。
3. **插件调用**：`await ctx.ttsService.configure({ provider: 'doubao', voices: { doubao: '音色 ID' } })`。

`tts_service_voices`（插件里用 `ctx.ttsService.voices(id)`）会列出音色、语言和听不听语气说明。列不全的会说明；
音色 ID 总是可以手填。

出错都明确报出来：平台没注册、语言不支持、文字超过平台的 `maxChars`、格式给不了，都会报错。服务不会悄悄换别的平台。

readme.section: 豆包语音合成 2.0（`tts-doubao`，平台 id `doubao`）
readme.text:
| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `providerId` | `doubao` | 同时开两份时改成不同的名字。 |
| `resourceId` | `seed-tts-2.0` | 作为 `X-Api-Resource-Id` 发出。 |
| `apiKeyEnv`、`accessKeyEnv`、`secretKeyEnv` | 见[密钥](#密钥) | |
| `sampleRate` | `24000` | 16 位单声道 PCM。 |
| `maxChars` | `300` | 单次请求。 |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | |

readme.section: 豆包语音合成 2.0（`tts-doubao`，平台 id `doubao`）
readme.text:
- 语气说明和“上文”（用户刚说的一句）合成一句语音指令，放进 `additions.context_texts`。**只有豆包 2.0 的系统音色**
  （ID 里带 `uranus`）听它，复刻音色不听。
- 列音色：没配 AK/SK 时，给一份从[官方音色列表](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6561/1257544)整理的 2.0 系统音色静态表，
  标为不完整；配了 AK/SK 就调官方 `ListSpeakers` 接口（HMAC-SHA256 签名，服务名 `speech_saas_prod`，地域 `cn-beijing`）。
- 语言：`auto`、`zh`、`en`、`ja`（作为 `explicit_language` 发出）。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `cosyvoice-v3-flash` | 例如 `cosyvoice-v3-flash`、`cosyvoice-v3-plus`、`cosyvoice-v2`、`cosyvoice-v3.5-flash`、`qwen-audio-3.1-tts-flash`、`qwen3-tts-flash`。音色只能配同型号用。 |
| `region` | `cn-beijing` | `cn-beijing`、`ap-southeast-1`、`cn-hongkong`、`us-east-1`、`eu-central-1`、`ap-northeast-1`。密钥、业务空间和型号按地域分开。 |
| `workspaceId` | — | API Host 的第一段（例如 `llm-xxx`）。填了就用业务空间专属域名 `{workspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com`，不填用旧的 DashScope 域名。德国、日本必须填。阿里云说明 DashScope 域名 2026-09-30 之后不再支持新功能，建议填上。 |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` | |
| `sampleRate` | `24000` | CosyVoice、Qwen-Audio-TTS 用；Qwen3-TTS 固定 24000。 |
| `maxChars` | Qwen3-TTS 600，其他 2000 | |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 含合成和下载音频。 |

- CosyVoice、Qwen-Audio-TTS 走 `/api/v1/services/audio/tts/SpeechSynthesizer`；Qwen3-TTS 走
  `/api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation`。两类都返回一个 24 小时有效的音频地址，插件再去下载。
- 语气说明（`instruction`），按官方说明：

| 型号 | 听不听自由描述的语气 |
  | --- | --- |
  | `qwen-audio-*` | 听：系统、复刻、设计音色都听（少数英文音色除外） |
  | `cosyvoice-v3.5-*` | 听（这个型号只有复刻和设计音色） |
  | `cosyvoice-v3-flash` | 只有复刻和设计音色听；系统音色只认官方规定的固定句式 |
  | `cosyvoice-v3-plus`、`cosyvoice-v2` | 不听 |
  | `qwen3-tts-instruct-*` | 听（作为 `instructions` 发出） |
  | `qwen3-tts-flash` | 不听 |

CosyVoice 的语气说明最多 100 个字符（汉字算两个）。
- 列音色：系统音色用从官方 [CosyVoice](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/cosyvoice-voice-list)、
  [Qwen-Audio-TTS](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/qwen-audio-tts-voice-list)、
  [Qwen3-TTS](https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/qwen-tts-voice-list) 音色列表整理的静态表；
  你自己的复刻和设计音色（属于所配型号的）用官方 `voice-enrollment` 的 `list_voice` 接口列出。

readme.section: OpenAI 兼容接口（`tts-openai-compatible`，平台 id `openai-compatible`）
readme.text:
| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `OpenAI 兼容接口` | 显示名。 |
| `baseUrl` | 必填 | 例如 `https://example.com/v1`；插件调用 `{baseUrl}/audio/speech`。 |
| `model` | 必填 | |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_TTS_API_KEY` | 留空就不带 `Authorization` 头。 |
| `instructions` | `false` | 端点支持 `instructions` 参数就设成 `true`。 |
| `voices` | `[]` | 手填的音色表，端点没有 `GET {baseUrl}/audio/voices` 时用；每项可以写 `instructions: false`。 |
| `languages` | `["auto"]` | 只用于选择时的校验，不随请求发出。 |
| `maxChars` | `4096` | |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | |

readme.section: OpenAI 兼容接口（`tts-openai-compatible`，平台 id `openai-compatible`）
readme.text:
插件总是请求 `response_format: "wav"`，需要端点返回 16 位 PCM 的 WAV。要接两个端点，就在 profile 里再加一行、换一个 `providerId`。

> 这**不是**“接 OpenAI”。注意 OpenAI 自家的三个语音模型计划在 2027-01-06 停用；要指向它之前，先看厂商当前的型号列表。

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `segments` | 1–12 段，按顺序说。每段有 `text` 和可选的 `tone`（一句简短的自然语言语气说明，最多 40 字）。 |
| `context` | 可选：用户刚说的一句（最多 60 字）。支持的平台用它把握语气。 |
| `target` | `auto`（默认）或某个去向的 id。 |

每段分别合成 16 位 PCM，段间留 0.25 秒静音，拼成一个 WAV，再交给一个去向。返回一个 JSON 字符串：`route`（去向 id，
或 `kept` 表示只存了文件）、`file`、`seconds`、`detail`、`unavailable`（哪些去向不可用、为什么），以及 `tone`：
有段落的语气没用上时会明确说出来，agent 下次就不用对这个音色白写语气了。

`tts-say` 的设置：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outputs` | `["speaker-windows"]` | `target: "auto"` 时依次尝试的去向，用第一个可用的。 |
| `maxChars` | `300` | 一次说的文字合计上限。 |
| `retentionDays` | `0` | 只保留最近 N 天（含今天）的音频；`0` 表示全部保留。 |

音频文件存在 `<DSH home>/tts-say/audio/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<HHMMSS>-<id>.wav`（本地日期），**不会自动删除**，除非设了
`retentionDays`。`<DSH home>` 默认是 `~/.dsh`，可以用 `DSH_HOME` 改。

列出当前选择，以及每个平台的音色。可选参数：`provider`、`language`、`search`（在 ID、名称、描述里找）、`refresh`。
每个平台最多显示 60 个。点停止会立刻结束，不用等平台回话。

替用户换音色。工具描述要求 agent **只在**你要求换音色、或明确同意某个音色时才用；这只是对模型的提示，
所以改动本身也在返回里写得看得见、能回退。

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `voice` | 必填：音色 ID。 |
| `provider` | 可选：平台 id；不给就用当前默认平台（当前也没有时会报错，要求给出）。 |

保存前先查这个平台的音色列表：列表完整却找不到这个 ID，就不保存，并让 agent 先用 `tts_service_voices` 查；列表不完整
或列不出来，就按手填的 ID 保存，并说明“不在已知列表里，合成失败时再改”。返回里总会写明：改前和改后的平台与音色
（知道名称就带上）、已经生效、在“语音合成服务”的设置里能看到也能改回，以及改回原样要填的值。

`speaker-windows`：最近 `presentMinutes`（默认 5）分钟内有键盘鼠标操作、且没锁屏，就算可用（经 Windows PowerShell：
`GetLastInputInfo`、`LogonUI.exe`）。播放用 `System.Media.SoundPlayer`，一次一段排队；工具不等播放结束。

平台就是一个注入 `ttsService` 的插件，注册一个实现了 `TtsProvider` 的对象（类型见 [`index.d.ts`](./index.d.ts)）：

```js
export const name = 'my-tts'
export const inject = ['ttsService']

export function apply(ctx) {

- `register` 遇到重复 id 会报错，返回一个异步的注销函数；插件卸载时 `ctx.effect` 会调用它。注销时先拒新请求，
  再中止进行中请求的 `signal`，等它们收尾。
- 语气说明真的用上了才报 `instructionsApplied: true`。
- 服务不做格式转换。自带的说话工具要的是 `pcm16`。

别的插件调用服务：`inject = ['ttsService']`，然后
`const audio = await ctx.ttsService.synthesize(ctx.ttsService.resolve({ text, formats: ['wav'] }), signal)`。

去向就是一个注入 `ttsSay` 的插件，注册一个 `VoiceOutput`，比如把语音发到某个聊天软件：

```js
export const name = 'my-voice-output'
export const inject = ['ttsSay']

export function apply(ctx) {

然后把它的 id 加进 `tts-say` 设置的 `outputs`，例如 `["speaker-windows", "my-chat"]`。

2026-11-04 用以下组合做过真实合成，都返回 24kHz 的 `pcm16`：

| 平台 | 型号 / 资源 | 音色 | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 豆包 | `seed-tts-2.0` | `ICL_uranus_zh_female_wenrounvshen_tob` | 语气说明生效 |
| 阿里百炼 | `cosyvoice-v3-flash` | 系统音色 | |
| 阿里百炼 | `qwen3-tts-flash` | 系统音色 | |
| 阿里百炼 | `qwen-audio-3.1-tts-flash` | 系统音色 | |

- 百炼 `qwen3-tts-instruct-*`：`instructions` 在 HTTP 请求体里的位置（`input.instructions`）是按官方 SDK 示例推的，
  HTTP 文档里没写。
- 百炼不填 `workspaceId` 时：旧的 DashScope 域名在 2026-09-30 之后还能不能调新型号，没有核实。型号被拒时请填 `workspaceId`。
- 文档没写单次字数上限的，取的是保守值：豆包 300，百炼 SpeechSynthesizer（CosyVoice、Qwen-Audio-TTS）2000。
  都可以用 `maxChars` 改。
- 豆包：`explicit_language` 的取值（现在发 `zh-cn`、`en`、`ja`），以及 `ListSpeakers` 返回里语言字段的格式，没有核实。
- 静态音色表是从官方页面整理的，可能不全或有误，所以用它列出的列表（没配 AK/SK 的豆包、百炼的全部列表）总是标为不完整，
  `tts_service_select` 也接受不在表里的 ID。音色 ID 总是可以手填。

各平台按各自的条款直接向你收费，本插件不收任何费用。

- 豆包 / 火山引擎：[计费概述](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/doubao-voice/billing-overview?lang=zh)、
  [火山引擎服务条款](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6256/64903)。
- 阿里百炼：[模型价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/billing-for-model-studio)、
  [相关协议](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/related-agreements)。
- OpenAI 兼容接口：以端点运营方的收费和条款为准。

要说的文字、语气说明和上文会发给你选的平台。豆包的请求发往 `openspeech.bytedance.com`（列音色发往
`open.volcengineapi.com`）；百炼的请求发往你所在地域的 DashScope 或业务空间域名，再从它返回的地址下载音频；
OpenAI 兼容接口的请求发往你填的 `baseUrl`。除非某个去向把音频发出去，不会有别的东西离开本机。

readme.section: 上游出了 `textToSpeech` 服务以后
readme.text:
DSH 的语音识别说明里把语音合成列为待办。真做出来，几乎肯定叫 `ctx.textToSpeech`。cordis 的服务名是全局的，
所以本包用 `ctx.ttsService`，两边可以同时存在。到时候我们发一个大版本迁过去：

1. 三家平台改成注册到上游的服务上。上游的平台接口缺我们要的能力（语气说明、上文、列音色）时，先在我们的平台实现里
   保留这些扩展，上游补上了再去掉；
2. 说话工具和去向改成调用上游的服务；
3. `ctx.ttsService` 退役，不留转发层。你的选择按下表迁过去，并提供一个一次性的迁移脚本：

| 这里（`tts-service` 设置和各平台条目） | 上游 |
| --- | --- |
| `provider` | 上游的默认平台 |
| `voices`（按平台） | 上游对应的各平台音色设置 |
| `language` | 上游的语言 |
| 各平台的 `apiKeyEnv`（以及豆包的 AK/SK 密钥名） | 同样的密钥名；密钥服务里存的值不用动 |

readme.section: 上游出了 `textToSpeech` 服务以后
readme.text: 这里的接口特意照着上游语音识别服务的形状写，所以到时候平台实现的改动应该很小。

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

测试用 `node --test`。所有网络调用都走假的 `fetch`，PowerShell 也是假的，所以测试不发任何网络请求，也不出声。
火山引擎签名用官方签名文档里的示例核对过。
